rows.ja: 提携・投資・事業売却

relations.text: FormFactorは2023年9月18日、FRT Metrology事業をCamtekへ売却する正式契約を結んだと発表した
relations.text_en: FormFactor announced on September 18, 2023 a definitive agreement to sell its FRT Metrology business to Camtek

source.label: FormFactor 10-K
source.quote: On September 18, 2023, the Company announced entry into a definitive agreement to sell its FRT Metrology (“FRT”) business to Camtek Ltd.

relations.text: Camtekを買い手、FormFactor GmbHを売り手とするFRT GmbHの株式譲渡契約(2023年9月17日付)がある
relations.text_en: A share purchase agreement dated September 17, 2023 names Camtek as purchaser and FormFactor GmbH as seller of FRT GmbH

source.label: FormFactor 10-K
source.quote: Share Purchase Agreement by and among Camtek, Ltd. as purchaser and FormFactor GmbH as seller and FormFactor, Inc as Parent and FRT GmbH as Company, dated as of September 17, 2023 10-K 000-50307 2/21/2025 10.31

relations.text: Advantest Americaが2025年1月10日、第三者割当でFormFactor普通株334,971株を1株44.78ドルで取得した
relations.text_en: Advantest America acquired 334,971 shares of FormFactor common stock in a private placement on January 10, 2025 at $44.78 per share

source.label: FormFactor 10-K
source.quote: On January 10, 2025, Advantest America, Inc., a Delaware corporation, acquired 334,971 shares of our common stock in a private placement for $ 44.78 per share, representing the 5-day trailing volume-weighted average price prior to signing the related private placement agreement.
source.note: 子会社(Advantest America)による取得です。

relations.text: FormFactorとTeradyneが次世代半導体テストを加速する戦略的協業を発表した
relations.text_en: FormFactor and Teradyne announced a strategic collaboration to accelerate next-generation semiconductor testing

source.label: FormFactor 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: FormFactor and Teradyne Announce Strategic Collaboration to Accelerate Next-Generation Semiconductor Testing

relations.text: 協業は、FormFactorのプローブ技術・インターフェース・テストエンジニアリングとTeradyneの自動テストプラットフォームを組み合わせる
relations.text_en: The collaboration combines FormFactor's probe technologies, interface solutions and test engineering with Teradyne's automated test platforms

source.label: FormFactor 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: The collaboration brings together FormFactor’s industry-leading expertise in probe technologies, interface solutions, test engineering, and device characterization with Teradyne’s advanced automated test platforms to help customers address growing semiconductor complexity.

relations.text: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.を管理代理人とする1.5億ドルのリボルビング融資枠の契約を2025年7月29日に結んだ
relations.text_en: FormFactor entered into a $150 million revolving credit facility on July 29, 2025 with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association as Administrative Agent

source.label: FormFactor 10-K
source.quote: On July 29, 2025, we entered into a Revolving Credit Agreement (the “Revolver”) with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as Administrative Agent, and the lenders party thereto, providing us with a $150 million revolving credit facility (the “Facility”).
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 同契約の書面(2025年7月29日付)が、Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.を管理代理人として開示されている
relations.text_en: The credit agreement dated July 29, 2025 names Wells Fargo Bank, National Association as Administrative Agent

source.label: FormFactor 10-K
source.quote: Credit Agreement, dated as of July 29, 2025, by and among FormFactor, Inc. and Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as Administrative Agent, and the lenders party thereto from time to time

relations.text: フォームファクターの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in FormFactor’s annual report

source.label: FormFactor 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors in the probe station market are MPI Corporation, Shenzhen Senmeixieer Technology Co., Ltd (“Semishare”), STAr Technologies, Inc., Tokyo Electron Limited (“TEL”), and Wentworth Laboratories, Inc.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
